description: This PHP class 'Store' in the OpenCart admin module manages the generation and clearing of JSON store configuration files, involving reading configuration data, creating directories, writing JSON files, and deleting existing files.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing store configuration JSON files within OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates JSON files for each language containing store information, creating directories and handling errors.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes existing store configuration JSON files for each language.
